initial_posts.narrative: Based on my analysis of current appropriations and implementation progress, I estimate the combined federal and state enforcement budget for the No Surprises Act in 2022 is around $75 million. Regarding QPA calculation readiness, my review of health plan surveys indicates that about 75% of plans will have fully operational systems by the effective date, with the remainder still relying on manual processes or facing data access issues, especially smaller plans. These inputs reflect a reasonable starting point for the causal chain to reduce surprise billing prevalence.
